```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE)
library(melbairbnbexplore)

library(ggplot2)
```

## Intended User & Question
**User:** Prospective Airbnb hosts in Melbourne.  
**Question:** How do location and property type affect nightly price for a property?

## Data
Source: InsideAirbnb Melbourne 2026-09-16 (25k listings)  
Raw: `data-raw/listings.csv` (70MB, 90 cols)  
Clean: `melb_airbnb` 5 cols - see `data-raw/melb_airbnb_raw.R`

```{r}
head(melb_airbnb)
```

## Package Function
```{r}
summarise_prices(melb_airbnb)
```

```{r}
melb_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood) |>
  summarise(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm=TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_price)) |>
  head(10) |>
  ggplot(aes(reorder(neighbourhood, avg_price), avg_price)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Neighbourhood", y="Avg Price AUD")
```

## Shiny App
Run `launch_app()` to explore prices by suburb and room type.
